comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop and verifies retained motion; PR-1300 places a nickel strip and spot-welds four battery terminals.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires concentric driver-and-wrench countertorque while preserving a screw setting; PR-1300 requires thin-strip placement and repeated dual-probe positioning.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades retained 90° opening, seated/retained nuts, three repeat cycles, drift and released clearance; PR-1300 grades strip alignment, four weld contacts/bonds, welder return and stillness. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Battery-tab placement and localized welding do not test coupled screw/jam-nut adjustment or retention of an articulated stop.
